text:
marie: quick sync — we need to finalize netops orchestration + rollback guardrails for private deploys. customer asks keep coming for static egress, predictable cutover windows, and minimal downtime. can we sketch a plan now?

ajay: +1. main ask from eng: define a safe cutover flow and an automatic rollback trigger. ops prefers 2h windows but willing to negotiate per-customer.

sam: 2h is fine for enterprise installs. tech constraints: ARP/route propagation, VPN rekey, and CX device failover times are the big unknowns. suggest we define small/medium/large classes with different windows.

diego: customer question: several want to preserve existing external IPs for egress. is that on the table? if not, we should provide a migration recipe.

marie: short answer: we can support static egress for Dedicated or with managed NAT per-tenant. for VPC-onprem customers we can document a NAT gateway option and a fallback NAT-ip-mapping playbook. we should enumerate acceptance criteria per deployment type.

ajay: propose a staged rollout pattern: (1) config dry-run + validation, (2) canary traffic mirror for 10-15m, (3) increment to 25% for 20m, (4) full cutover. Insert a "firebreak" pause after canary to validate metrics. auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases >1% or p95 latency regresses >40%.

sam: add probes we can run during the firebreak: `GET /health` (200), auth end-to-end walk (sample request), and a tokenized inference probe measuring latency and output diffs. Also, check IP preservation by verifying `curl ipinfo.io/ip` pre/post.

diego: for customers wanting IP continuity: snippet we could offer (terraform managed NAT) — saves time:
```hcl
resource "aws_eip" "tenant_nat" {
  vpc = true
}
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "tenant" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.tenant_nat.id
  subnet_id = var.public_subnet
}
```

sam: operational notes: ensure the routing table swap is atomic from the customer's perspective. do the swap behind a proxy so we can quickly flip back if health checks fail. also document the DNS TTL recommendations (60s for short windows).

marie: good. we also need a rollback checklist for runbooks (what to revert, who pings the customer, postmortem owner). propose:
- owner: netops oncall + eng runtime lead
- immediate rollback action: restore previous route and NAT, disable new canary, revert feature flags
- notify list: account manager + customer success + PM

ajay: automation idea: a small lambda that monitors canary metrics and triggers terraform apply to revert if thresholds breached. keep human-in-the-loop for final rollback decision for customers with SLA >99.9%.

netops-bot: reminder: tentative change window for customer pilot scheduled 2026-04-01 22:00 UTC — add to calendar and confirm peering.

marie: next steps — i will draft a minimal orchestration spec with the three rollout classes (small/medium/large), the firebreak timings, and the exact metric thresholds. @ajay can you own the rollback automation prototype? @sam can you write the probe checklist and NAT playbook? @diego please capture customer IP continuity asks and sample comms. I'll collate and share a one-pager by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

sam: ack — will add edge cases (airgapped installs, deterministic IP reuse failures)

diego: ack and will draft the customer comms template.

ajay: assigning provisional PR to eng-runtime for the automation spike. will demo next Wed.

marie: thanks all. this thread will be the working thread for the orchestration spec. drop quick updates here, keep messages short.
